description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ reportedly appeared on South Korea's Safety Korea certification website with the model numbers SM-X840 and SM-X846N. The latter is said to be linked to the South Korean variant of the tablet. The listing shows that the tablet will continue to feature a selfie camera within the top bezel rather than adopting a display cutout. The listing indicates that the tablet is on track for launch.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ Listed on Safety Korea Certification Database With Live Images: Report

description: WhatsApp has started developing a new feature that will send in-app notifications to users on the date of the birthdays of their contacts, according to a report. The instant messaging app was spotted testing the functionality in the WhatsApp for Android Beta 2.26.27.3 update, which is said to be currently available via the Google Play Store. With the update, WhatsApp has reportedly added a new dedicated section, which will list the upcoming birthdays of the user’s contacts. This will reportedly eliminate the need for users to keep a record of their friends and family members’ birthdays in a separate calendar app.
title: WhatsApp Might Be Working on a Birthday Notification Feature for Saved Contacts

description: A new leak suggests the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 could be the company's final clamshell foldable smartphone. A tipster claimed the upcoming handset may be Samsung's last small foldable product, although the information was not presented as final. The Galaxy Z Flip 8 is still expected to debut at the Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22 alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and new Galaxy Watch models. Previous leaks have also revealed its expected design, colour options, and key specifications.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Could Mark the End of Flip the Company's Foldables, Tipster Claims

description: At the sidelines of the Phone (4b) launch, we sat down with Nothing's Akis Evangelidis, Co-founder and India President, to pull back the curtain on the engineering realities of navigating a global tech crunch and the all-new smartphone range. In a characteristically candid conversation, Evangelidis calls out competitor battery spec "gimmicks," explains why premium aspiration beats cheap value for money, and details how a last-minute locker-room handshake turned into an ultra-exclusive, championship-inspired Red phone.
title: Nothing's Akis on the Phone (4b) and Navigating the 2026 Smartphone Crunch

description: Samsung is expected to unveil its next-generation foldables at its Galaxy Unpacked event later this month, including the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8. Soon after renders of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8 surfaced, a fresh leak has suggested that the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra could borrow several camera capabilities from the company’s non-foldable flagship, the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Could Borrow Galaxy S26 Ultra Camera Features, Tipster Claims

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro key specifications and features have surfaced online. The handset could be powered by Qualcomm’s unreleased Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 series chipset, which could be built on a 2nm process. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is tipped to sport a compact flat display, surrounded by relatively thin bezels. For optics, the smartphone will reportedly be equipped with a 200-megapixel primary rear camera, coupled with a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. Xiaomi’s next-generation handset could be backed by a 7,000mAh battery. It might also offer support for 100W wired fast charging and wireless charging.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Detailed Specifications Leaked, Might Feature Two 200-Megapixel Cameras, Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 Series Chip

description: BSNL has launched the Satellite Phone in India at Rs. 1,34,166 to provide connectivity in areas without conventional mobile network coverage. The Inmarsat-based handset supports satellite voice calls and SMS services and is aimed at defence, maritime operations, disaster response, mining, remote operations, and adventure travel. It also offers an SOS emergency feature, a rugged design, and a long-lasting battery. PTI reported that BSNL continues to offer dedicated prepaid and postpaid satellite service plans for government and commercial users.
title: BSNL Satellite Phone With Inmarsat Connectivity Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro is confirmed to come with a 9,000mAh battery with support for 67W wired fast charging and 22.5W reverse wired charging. It will have a flat screen with 1.5K resolution. Additionally, a Redmi Note 17 series phone surfaced on the NCC platform with model number 2609FRA74G. The Redmi Note 17 Pro is already teased to have Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection and an IP66 + IP68 + IP69 + IP69K-rated build. The launch of the phone will take place in China on July 14.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Battery, Display Details Teased as Handset Surfaces on Taiwan's NCC Database

description: Google has started rolling out Video Remix, a new AI-powered editing feature in Google Photos that uses the Gemini Omni model to transform short videos with preset templates. Users can apply cinematic relighting, artistic styles, and background changes without manual editing. The feature is available from the Create tab and currently supports videos up to 10 seconds long. Video Remix is rolling out to eligible Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers in select countries, including India.
title: Google Photos Updated With Video Remix Feature Powered By Gemini Omni
Think Foldables Have Weak Cameras? This Phone Changed That in India

description: Xbox Game Pass reportedly has 30 million subscribers, 4 million fewer than it did in 2024. According to two separate reports, Microsoft's game subscription service has lost millions of subscribers in the last two years. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said this week that Game Pass "id not grow at the pace we expected."
title: Xbox Game Pass Has Reportedly Lost 4 Million Subscribers Since 2024

description: iPhone Ultra's production is on schedule for Apple's first foldable handset to go on sale in September, according to a report citing multiple “supply chain sources” (translated from Chinese). The design of the foldable has reportedly been finalised. The iPhone Ultra is said to have reached the “peak production” (translated from Chinese) stage. Further, the report highlights that delivering Apple’s first foldable iPhone by September should not be a problem. The report contradicts a recent article published by TF International Security analyst Ming-Chi Kuo on X. The analyst predicted that the Cupertino-based tech giant will follow a similar sale cycle for the iPhone Ultra as the iPhone X.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone on Track to Ship By September, Handset Currently in Mass Production: Report

description: Google Search recorded its highest usage in history on July 7, following Argentina's dramatic victory over Egypt in the FIFA World Cup Round of 16. According to the company, Search surpassed all previous traffic records right after Argentina scored its winner in stoppage time. The latest milestone comes nearly four years after Google reported a similar traffic surge in 2022, and that is said to have occurred during the 2022 FIFA World Cup final.
title: Google Search Hits All-Time Usage Record During Argentina’s Dramatic World Cup Win Over Egypt

description: Dell has launched a new workstation lineup in India. The series includes Pro Precision 5 series (14S,16S), Dell Pro Precision 5 series (14,16), Dell Pro Precision 7 series (14,16) and the Dell Pro Precision 7 T1. The Dell Pro Precision 5 series featuring the 14S,16S models ship with up to Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors. The Dell Pro Precision 5 14 and Pro Precision 5 16 run on Intel Core Ultra 9 Series 3 processors.
title: Dell Pro Precision 5, Pro Precision 7, Pro Precision 7 T1 Series Launched in India With Up to Intel Core Ultra Series 3 Chips

description: iQOO Z11 Lite will be launched in India on July 24, iQOO India CEO Nipun Marya announced on Thursday. Apart from this, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone is now live in the country, confirming various details. The iQOO Z11 Lite is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Amazon. It will be offered in Midnight Blue and Solar Flame colour options. The handset will be powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. The tech firm claims that the phone managed to score more than 5,79,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite Colourways, Key Features Revealed; Will Launch in India Later This Month

description: Xiaomi on Thursday expanded its electric vehicle (EV) portfolio with the introduction of the SkyNomad series. Positioned as a new lineup of intelligent, reconfigurable large-space SUVs, it joins the company’s existing EV portfolio, which already includes the Xiaomi SU7, SU7 Ultra, and YU7 models. While the aforementioned vehicles are performance-focused models, Xiaomi says the SkyNomad series is geared towards delivering passenger comfort and adaptable interior space. It offers configurable seating layouts and AI-powered smart cabin features.
title: Xiaomi SkyNomad Series EVs Announced With Reconfigurable Cabin, New Kunlun Architecture

description: Global PC shipments declined 4.9 percent YoY in Q2 this year to 68.2 million units, according to the latest IDC report. This is the first decline after nine consecutive quarters of growth, and the memory chip shortage is the key reason behind the fall. Additionally, storage and geopolitical issues also continued to weigh on the market. Lenovo came in the top spot with 24.4 percent market share, followed by HP, Dell, Apple and Asus.
title: Global PC Shipments Fell 4.9 Percent in Q2 2026 Amid RAM Shortage, Apple Gains Ground: Report

description: Oppo has started selling the Reno 16 and Reno 16c smartphones in India alongside the new Oppo Bubble smart camera companion. The Reno 16 series starts at Rs. 46,999, while the Oppo Bubble is priced at Rs. 7,999. Buyers can avail cashback, exchange bonuses, zero down payment schemes, and screen damage protection as part of launch offers. The smartphones feature AMOLED displays, Android 16-based ColorOS 16, Snapdragon and MediaTek chipsets, 50-megapixel cameras, and support for 80W wired fast charging.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16c Go on Sale in India Alongside Oppo Bubble: Price, Offers, Features

description: OpenAI has launched GPT Live, a new voice system that now powers ChatGPT Voice with more natural conversations and simultaneous listening and speaking. GPT Live 1 and GPT Live 1 mini are rolling out globally across iOS, Android, the web, and CarPlay. The new models can delegate complex tasks to GPT 5.5, support live translation, display visual cards, and improve conversational flow. OpenAI has also introduced new safety measures, enhanced language support, and updated voice interactions for users.
title: ChatGPT Voice Gets GPT Live Upgrade With Real-Time Conversations

description: With the Galaxy Unpacked event less than two weeks away, leaks are now painting a clearer picture of the company's upcoming foldables. Shortly after official-looking renders of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 surfaced online, images of Samsung’s next-generation clamshell-style foldable, widely referred to as the Galaxy Z Flip 8, have now been reportedly leaked. Based on the leaked renders, the handset could follow the design language of its predecessor, albeit with refreshed colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Renders Hint at Familiar Design, Could Arrive in Three Colourways

description: Truecaller CEO Rishit Jhunjhunwala, in a post on X on Wednesday, revealed that in late 2025, TRAI asked Truecaller not to display community reports and spam information against 140 and 1600 series numbers, restricting the company from tagging such numbers as spam. Recently, a report highlighted that TRAI is seeking more powers from MeitY to regulate call management apps and online platforms, like Truecaller, for “wrongfully” tagging and blocking phone numbers starting with “140” and “1600”.
title: Truecaller CEO Criticises TRAI Policy, Says Users Overwhelmingly Choose to Block ‘Verified’ Spam

description: Obsidian Entertainment has reportedly cancelled multiple unannounced projects to shift its focus to making a new Fallout game. The studio is said to have cancelled a planned sequel to Avowed, which released last year. The changes come as part of wider restructuring at Xbox, which also reportedly led to a quarter of Obsidian's employees being laid off.
title: Obsidian Reportedly Cancels Avowed Sequel to Start Work on New Fallout Game in Wake of Xbox Restructuring

description: Realme Narzo 100x 5G is confirmed to launch in India next week. It will go on sale through Amazon in two colour options. The upcoming phone will run on a  MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset paired with up to 14GB of dynamic RAM and 256GB of storage. It will include an 8,000mAh battery and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. The phone will run on  Realme UI 7.0 based on Android 16. The display will deliver a 144 Hz refresh rate and 1,200nits peak brightness.
title: Realme Narzo 100x 5G India Launch Announced; Key Specifications and Features Teased

description: The Samsung Galaxy Unpacked event is just around the corner, where the South Korean tech conglomerate is expected to unveil its next-generation foldable smartphones. While Samsung has yet to confirm the handsets, official renders of the purported Galaxy Z Fold 8 have now been leaked. According to a report, the images provide us with a clear glimpse of the redesigned form factor of the rumoured wide-foldable, along with its colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Renders Reportedly Leak Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked; Reveal Shorter, Wider Foldable

description: Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 series in September. In recent months, the Cupertino-based tech giant has been grappling with rising memory and component costs that have already contributed to price increases across several of its recent products. A new report suggests that Apple could be exploring an alternative source for one of its key components. It is said to have begun testing DRAM chips from a Chinese memory manufacturer that is currently on the US trade blacklist.
title: Apple Reportedly Testing DRAM Chips From Blacklisted Chinese Supplier Ahead of iPhone 18 Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 official renders have leaked ahead of their expected July 22 launch. The Galaxy Watch 9 appears in 40mm and 44mm sizes with Cream, Green and Graphite colour options, while the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is shown in Grey and Silver. The images suggest both smartwatches retain designs similar to their predecessors. The leak also indicates price increases for the Galaxy Watch 9 lineup and the LTE-only Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 across several markets.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9, Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 Leaked Renders Reveal Design, Colourways

description: Meta, in a new blog post, confirmed that users who attempt to cover the white light that blinks while the AI glasses are recording will find their camera disabled. Beginning with the second generation of glasses, the camera is automatically disabled if Meta detects that the capture LED has been blocked. The update follows widespread privacy concerns surrounding the use of smart glasses in public spaces. Meta assured that it is working to remove ads, posts, and Marketplace listings that advertise tampering services.
title: Meta Disables Recording on Its Smart Glasses When the Capture LED Is Concealed

description: Google Pixel Watch 5 will be launched at a notably higher price than the Pixel Watch 4, according to a report. The smartwatch is expected to go on sale in select global markets on August 20. The 41mm model of the upcoming Google Pixel Watch 5 will reportedly go on sale in select global markets in Anthracite, Pyrite, Rose Gold, and Silver colour options. Meanwhile, the higher-end model with a 45mm dial could be offered in Black, Green, and Silver colourways. The company is expected to launch the Pixel Watch 5 on August 12 at 3:00 pm PT, during the Made by Google event.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Will Reportedly Get Pricier, More Details Surface Online Ahead of Launch
